alternatives_rejected.why: Its latency-90 deviation (z=82) is much smaller than currencyservice's (z=408), and checkoutservice calls currencyservice, so its slowdown fits propagated latency (E1, E2).

Frontend latency (z=103/69) is downstream of the currencyservice slowdown, which callers observe as 5.13->204.83ms inbound latency (E2); a self-inflicted frontend fault would not explain the currencyservice spike being the largest (E1).

proposed_fix.description: Inspect and remove any injected network delay (for example tc/netem rules) on the currencyservice pod's network interface, or restart the currencyservice pod to clear it. Then confirm that inbound latency returns to its ~5ms baseline.
